title: S'mores Summer Cupcakes
shortDescription: Chocolate cupcakes with a graham crumb base, marshmallow filling, and torched marshmallow frosting, ready in about 45 minutes.
description: These cupcakes taste like a campfire treat in cake form. I built a graham style crumb into the batter, then added a rich chocolate cake on top of it. Each cupcake gets a marshmallow fluff center and a big swirl of toasted marshmallow frosting I tested this recipe three times in my home kitchen before the marshmallow layer stayed put during baking. The trick is a light press of crumb into the liners, not a full crust. That way the chocolate cake still rises tall and stays moist. This batch is nut-free, so it works for school events and summer parties without extra swaps. The torched marshmallow top is optional but it makes these look like the real dessert. A kitchen torch gives the best toasted marks, but a quick broiler pass works too.
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs (about 8 full sheets, finely crushed)
8 oz semisweet chocolate, chopped (for ganache drizzle)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 12 cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter. Press a thin, even layer into the bottom of each liner.
Whisk flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl.
In a large bowl, whisk sugar, oil, eggs, and vanilla until smooth.
Add the dry mix to the wet mix in three parts, alternating with buttermilk. Mix until just combined.
Spoon batter over the graham layer, filling each liner about two thirds full.
Bake 16 to 18 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the pan 5 minutes, then move to a wire rack.
Once cool, cut a small cone from the center of each cupcake and fill with a spoonful of marshmallow fluff. Replace the cut top piece.
Heat heavy cream until just simmering, then pour over chopped chocolate. Let sit 2 minutes, then stir into a smooth ganache.
Pile mini marshmallows on top of each cupcake. Toast lightly with a kitchen torch until golden, or broil 30 to 60 seconds watching closely.
Drizzle toasted cupcakes with warm ganache right before serving.
tips: Keep the graham layer thin. A thick layer turns gummy under the batter.
Toast marshmallows right before serving so they stay soft in the center.
If using a broiler, keep the oven door open and watch the whole time. Marshmallows burn fast.
Room temperature eggs and buttermilk help the cake rise evenly.

faq.question: Can I make these without a kitchen torch?
faq.answer: Yes, use your oven broiler on high. Place cupcakes on the top rack for 30 to 60 seconds and watch them the entire time.

faq.question: Will the marshmallow filling leak out during baking?
faq.answer: No, because you add the fluff after baking. Cut a small cone from the cooled cupcake, fill it, then put the plug back.

faq.question: Can I make the graham crumb layer gluten free?
faq.answer: Yes, swap in gluten free graham crackers and check that your flour blend has a 1:1 substitution ratio.

faq.question: How far ahead can I bake these cupcakes?
faq.answer: Bake the cake base up to 2 days ahead and store covered at room temperature. Add fluff, marshmallows, and ganache the day you serve them.

conclusion: These cupcakes bring the campfire indoors without any special equipment beyond a torch or broiler. The graham base, rich chocolate cake, and toasted marshmallow top make a summer party dessert that holds up well outdoors too.
metaDescription: Try this s'mores summer cupcakes recipe with graham crumb, chocolate cake, and toasted marshmallow. Nut-free and ready in under an hour, bake today.
